description: This Java source file defines the 'Sender' class responsible for sending messages to Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) / Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) service. It includes methods for constructing and sending messages, handling retries, parsing responses, and managing HTTP connections.

classes.name: Sender
classes.description: Helper class to send messages to the GCM/FCM service using an API key. Handles message construction, retries, response parsing, and HTTP communication.

methods.name: Sender
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the sender with an API key and endpoint URL.

methods.name: getEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the current endpoint URL used for sending messages.

methods.description: Sets the connection timeout in milliseconds for HTTP connections.

methods.name: setReadTimeout
methods.description: Sets the read timeout in milliseconds for HTTP connections.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to a single device with retries, returning the result.

methods.name: sendNoRetry
methods.description: Sends a message without retries, returning the result or null if unsuccessful.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a message to multiple devices with retries, returning a multicast result.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of message results and determines which registration IDs need to be retried.

methods.name: sendNoRetry
methods.description: Sends a message to multiple registration IDs without retries.

methods.description: Performs the HTTP request to the GCM endpoint with the provided JSON payload.
